_comment: Official sources the evidence-expansion fetcher may read (scripts/acquisition/fetch_official_sources.py). Only official publishers: an institution's own website for its curriculum, an employer's own job board (served through the employer's applicant-tracking provider's documented public API) for its job postings. Every entry records why it is legitimate and what it is used for. Files land in the drop folders with a .source.json sidecar; nothing is analysed until it is registered and passes the pipeline's gates. Raw downloads are never redistributed (excluded from release packages).
user_agent: SkillGapCurriculumResearch/1.0 (academic curriculum-industry alignment study; contact: project owner)

peer_documents.licence_note: no licence statement in the document; official public document of the institute, used for analysis with attribution, not redistributed

peer_documents_not_acquired.name: IIT Madras B.Tech CSE
peer_documents_not_acquired.reason: the official 2024-batch curriculum (iitm.ac.in) lists course codes and credits only; no topic content to compare

peer_documents_not_acquired.name: IIT Delhi B.Tech CSE
peer_documents_not_acquired.reason: the official 'Courses of Study 2024 - Course Descriptions' (home.iitd.ac.in) is an institute-wide catalogue; the B.Tech CSE programme's course list is in a separate volume and the CSE section could not be verified; comparing a whole-institute catalogue with one programme would be wrong

job_boards._comment: Employer job boards served by the employer's ATS through a documented public read API (no key, no login). Greenhouse: 'Job Board data is publicly available, so authentication is not required for any GET endpoints' (developers.greenhouse.io/job-board.html). Lever: GET /v0/postings/SITE needs no key; published postings are publicly viewable (github.com/lever/postings-api). Only postings located in India are kept. The posting date is taken ONLY from the source: Greenhouse first_published, Lever createdAt; a posting without one is kept as UNDATED (never given a date). verified_on = the board answered with India postings when checked.
job_boards.population_definition: postings located in India that were open on the snapshot date on the official job boards of the listed employers (public ATS APIs); one collection method, one geography
